product.name: Monoprice 8-Port 10/100Mbps Fast Ethernet Unmanaged Switch
product.description: Monoprice™8‑Port Fast Ethernet Unmanaged SwitchCompact desktop 8‑port 10/100Mbps Ethernet network switchThe Monoprice™ 8‑Port Fast Ethernet Switch is a simple and reliable way to add devices to your network. Easily add eight 10/100Mbps RJ45 Ethernet ports to your existing Ethernet network. This switch provides fast and robust connectivity using Cat5e or Cat6 cabling to distances up to 328 feet (100 meters). It is a true plug and play device that requires no drivers, configuration, or setup of any kind. Its compact size allows you to place it in confined spaces, such as inside a media panel, or even attach it to a wall.Eight 10/100Mbps RJ45 Fast Ethernet portsCompact sizePlug and play, no drivers or configuration requiredSupports Auto Negotiation and Auto MDI/MDIXSupports IEEE 802.3x flow control2K MAC address table ROBUST NETWORK CONNECTIVITYEasily expand your network and take advantage of the dependability of a wired network connection. Ensure robust file transfers using Cat5e or Cat6 cabling to distances up to 328 feet (100 meters). PLUG AND PLAYThis switch is a true plug and play device, requiring no drivers or special configuration of any kind. Simply connect it to your existing network, then plug in network‑enabled devices, such as computers, laptops, A/V receivers, and smart TVs to get the most out of your home network. COMPACT SIZEMeasuring 5.3" wide, this 8‑port Fast Ethernet Switch is compact enough to place in confined spaces, such as media panels or entertainment centers, or mounted to a wall, without taking up too much space. LED INDICATORSThe LED indicators allow you to see your network status at a glance, with simple diagnostics, such as power status and LAN activity/link status for each individual port. SUPPORTS AUTO NEGOTIATION AND AUTO MDI/MDXThis switch supports Auto Negotiation, allowing it to set the optimal duplex mode and speed to communicate with each connected device.
